messages:
alex: Quick check — we're planning a canary deploy for the chat/completions change (messages schema + toolcall param rename). Can we confirm behavior for older clients that still send `tool_args` instead of `tool_params`?

maria: Are we doing an automatic fallback in the API layer or expecting SDKs to normalize?

alex: fallback in API layer for now. The behavior we discussed: accept both keys, prefer `tool_params`, log a metric `compat.tool_args_seen`, and send a warning header `X-Compat-Warning: tool_args-deprecated`.

sam: sounds good. Two quick clarifications: 1) streaming deltas — do we include the toolcall `end` event when the caller used `tool_args`? 2) will the fallback be behind a feature flag for the first week?

maria: 1) yes, streaming shape unchanged — we still emit funccall events in deltas. 2) yes, flag `compat-fallback-toolargs` on by default for canary, we can toggle per-region.

jen: I opened the CR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/432 — added a small middleware to normalize and some unit tests. PTAL @sam @maria.

sam: looking now. Small nit: you used `normalize_tool_args(req)` in the middleware, but in the runtime path we need to ensure KV-cache keys use the normalized shape or else cache misses could happen. Add a call in the cache-key builder: `cacheKey.normalizeShape()` or similar.

jen: good catch. I'll add it. Also adding an integration test that hits streaming + toolcall to verify no duplicate partials.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for service/chat-completions:canary -> infra-3 @ 2024-10-21T15:22:10Z

alex: timeline: roll to 5% traffic in canary today, watch `latency.per_token`, `error.rate`, and `compat.tool_args_seen`. If `compat.tool_args_seen` > 0.5% we plan to keep fallback for 2 weeks then drop.

maria: telemetry: I'll add a dashboard tile showing `compat.tool_args_seen` and streaming reassembly errors. Also add alert: if reassembly errors > 0.1% for 5m, page eng-oncall.

ci-bot: CI green on PR 432 — unit + integration + e2e streaming tests passed.

sam: pinging runtime owners — @runtime-team we rely on kernel selection not to change when payload shape normalized. If you see cache churn during canary, notify here.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll start the rollout in 15m. Please drop quick notes here if you see regressions. :thumbsup:
